text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash, crash!)

Hmm, so that concludes the warm-up, does it?
Now then—here I come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrroooom, WHRRRRR!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You saw something?
Gimlet, at the training grounds――
what did you see?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahaha! Hear me!
What I saw, or rather witnessed, was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The Wandering "Tin Can"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a robot appeared?
At the training grounds?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, apparently a metal chunk with arms and legs
was walking around. There have been multiple sightings."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide... I could understand a cleaning machine
or something, but an actual robot is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman's PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, attention!
Students of Tracen Academy, lend me your ears!
This is Chairwoman Akikawa!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman's PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"‘I have something I want to show everyone.
Whoever's free, gather at the training grounds at once!’"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, an assembly?
What the hell is this about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A summons from Chairwoman Akikawa.
And a strange rumor at the training grounds:
'I saw a robot!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were too many things on my mind.
I decided to hurry outside as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well met! Thank you all for gathering.
There is someone here today whom I simply must introduce to you all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Since there are witnesses, I think it's time
to make a formal introduction. Come on, over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrr-vrrr-vroooom!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And appearing alongside the whir of an electric motor was...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Wheelchair
text_block_list.text: I am Sugar Lights. Pardon me for remaining seated in my wheelchair. My legs are somewhat impaired, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Everyone calls me "Dr. Wright."
I even designed this standing wheelchair myself.
Yes, I am—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: —Doctor of Engineering. An Umamusume who specializes in mecha development.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Specializing in mecha development...
Then after all, that rumor must be...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Then—allow me to unveil it once more.
Boot up! Come forth, ST-2!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash, crash!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What!? This is—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Mecha Umamusume "ST-2".

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
A bipedal robot capable of running at speeds
rivalling a real Umamusume. It is still under development, however.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yes, what I saw was
this "unfinished work."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"So it really does exist...
However, you just said it's 'under development'..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! This ST-2 is still incomplete,
and further development requires the aid of an Umamusume test model.
So—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Recruitment! I've come to gather those
who are willing to lend a hand to Tracen Academy, you see!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Cooperation, huh.
However, the fundamental issue is..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Can you really control it properly with video game controls like that?
Bipedal locomotion drive control should be quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh, it seems someone knows their stuff.
Naturally, you cannot control their running
freely with a controller like this."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
There is a different, official method
to control this ST-2.
choice_data_list: An official control method? That means...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's show them the true control system.
ST-2, Open Brain.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Dive in!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Testing, testing. Can you hear me?
My consciousness has now entered ST-2
and completely merged with it.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
This ST-2 is directly linked to my consciousness,
a mecha that moves at my absolute command.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
At will?!
It's true... Even the voice turned into Dr. Wright's...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, emergence, is it?
Then show me—an even deeper abyss.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the threshold between death and rebirth,
just how fast can I sprint?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that was the plan from the beginning.
Now then, have a look.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Just how far robotics has evolved today...
Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a resounding cry,
Mecha Umamusume ST-2 took off running!
Took off, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech, clunk, screeech, clunk!)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: So slow!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Not yet, just a little more! If it's just a bit longer...
TAAAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
ST-2 gave it everything it had. Yet despite that,
the Mecha Umamusume's speed showed no sign of increasing.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
For now! This is! My limit...! ...is what it is.
However...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: "Please lend me your strength. Until the day I can run just like a real Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The same as the real thing, huh...
If that's the best it can run, that's just impossible, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was never really into robots to begin with,
so I don't think I can be of much help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reality was laid bare. One after another, the Umamusume began losing interest, but...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Look closely, look even closer!
This ST-2 can make it, it can definitely make it...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I'm betting everything on this machine!
This is... all I have left!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, seeing Dr. Reitz looking so desperate,
I felt it would be a bit cruel
to turn her away like this.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should listen a little longer...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, a part of me was quite intrigued. I decided to ask for more details on a later date.
